diagnostic.source:
import ComputerLifecycleWitnesses
import Lean.Util.CollectAxioms

/-! PRIVATE deliberate finish-guard fault. A and B BOTH target v2. Wrong effect:
A's success prematurely publishes B's stored target and clears B's pending op;
it is NOT a demonstration of A publishing an older target. No native run claimed. -/
namespace ComputerLifecycle.FinishGuardDiagnostic
open ComputerLifecycle.Fixture

def oldCompletion := runWorker newerClaim.rows context allGood 0 690 .commitAck

def directExpected : Row :=
  { tenant := 11, principal := 13, custody := custody, ready := true
    provisioning := ⟨"v2", "complete-new-template/config/policy/images/secret-references"⟩
    operation := none, noticeShown := false, failure := none, notice := none
    collectedAt := none, keepOn := true
    storageFrame := "created_at=retained;all-unprojected-columns" }

theorem put_same (rows : Table) (id : Nat) (first last : Option Row) :
    put (put rows id first) id last = put rows id last := by
  funext subject
  by_cases same : subject = id <;> simp [put, same]

theorem put_expected (row : Row) : put base 7 (some row) = expectedRows row := by
  funext id
  by_cases same : id = 7 <;> simp [put, base, expectedRows, same]

/-- Genuine A claim followed by newer stale takeover B,not a supplied post-state. -/
theorem actual_newer_claim : claimed.matched = true ∧ newerClaim.matched = true ∧
    newerClaim.rows = expectedRows expectedNewerClaim ∧ context.operation = 70 ∧ newerContext.operation = 71 := by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
  change put (put base 7 (some (expectedClaim seed 70 next 0)))
    7 (some expectedNewerClaim) = _
  rw [put_same]
  exact put_expected expectedNewerClaim

/-- Actual old-context native continuation and resulting COMPLETE wrong table.
Independent literal expectedSuccess is reused as wrong early B-publication output. -/
theorem actual_wrong_worker :
    oldCompletion.native.attempts = expectedAttempts context ∧ oldCompletion.native.result = .ok () ∧
    oldCompletion.native.native = 9 ∧ oldCompletion.recorded.response = .ok true ∧
    oldCompletion.recorded.rows = expectedRows expectedSuccess ∧
    oldCompletion.loggedRecordingError = none ∧
    (oldCompletion.recorded.rows 7).bind (·.operation) = none := by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
  change put (put (put base 7 (some (expectedClaim seed 70 next 0)))
    7 (some expectedNewerClaim)) 7 (some expectedSuccess) = _
  repeat rw [put_same]
  exact put_expected expectedSuccess

theorem wrong_table_changed : oldCompletion.recorded.rows ≠ newerClaim.rows := by
  intro same
  have row := congrFun same 7
  have operation := congrArg (fun value : Option Row => value.bind (·.operation)) row
  change none = some (Operation.mk 71 661 next) at operation
  cases operation

/-- Negate the actual instantiated unchanged stale_worker output contract. -/
theorem rejects_stale_worker :
    ¬(oldCompletion.recorded.rows = newerClaim.rows ∧ oldCompletion.recorded.response = .ok false) := by
  intro preserved
  exact wrong_table_changed preserved.1

/-- Connect separately to the EXACT direct finish(None) call in the original
Fixture.actual_stale_history assertion. Full direct row differs only in notice. -/
theorem direct_finish_wrong :
    (finish newerClaim.rows key 70 none).matched = true ∧
    (finish newerClaim.rows key 70 none).rows = expectedRows directExpected ∧
    ¬RejectedCompletion newerClaim.rows (finish newerClaim.rows key 70 none)
      (fail newerClaim.rows key 70 ⟨"obsolete", 700, "v2"⟩) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change put (put (put base 7 (some (expectedClaim seed 70 next 0)))
      7 (some expectedNewerClaim)) 7 (some directExpected) = _
    repeat rw [put_same]
    exact put_expected directExpected
  · intro rejected
    have wrong : true = false := rejected.2.1
    cases wrong

#print axioms actual_newer_claim
#print axioms actual_wrong_worker
#print axioms rejects_stale_worker
#print axioms direct_finish_wrong

run_cmd do
  for declaration in [``put_same, ``put_expected, ``actual_newer_claim, ``actual_wrong_worker,
      ``wrong_table_changed, ``rejects_stale_worker, ``direct_finish_wrong] do
    let axioms ← Lean.collectAxioms declaration
    for name in axioms do
      unless name == ``propext || name == ``Classical.choice || name == ``Quot.sound do
        throwError "unexpected finish-guard fault diagnostic axiom in {declaration}: {name}"

end ComputerLifecycle.FinishGuardDiagnostic

diagnostic.source:
import ComputerLifecycleWitnesses
import Lean.Util.CollectAxioms

/-! PRIVATE deliberate missing-listener-stage fault. All unchanged observation
results are synthetic successes;effect marker9 is NOT a number of attempted calls.
The actual worker records full success after only eight logical attempts. -/
namespace ComputerLifecycle.ListenerOmissionDiagnostic
open ComputerLifecycle.Fixture

def expectedEight : List Invocation :=
  [⟨context.key, context.operation, context.target, .forSpec⟩,
   ⟨context.key, context.operation, context.target, .remove⟩,
   ⟨context.key, context.operation, context.target, .connect⟩,
   ⟨context.key, context.operation, context.target, .deleteTemplate⟩,
   ⟨context.key, context.operation, context.target, .buildTemplate⟩,
   ⟨context.key, context.operation, context.target, .createTemplate⟩,
   ⟨context.key, context.operation, context.target, .createSandbox⟩,
   ⟨context.key, context.operation, context.target, .waitReady⟩]

theorem put_same (rows : Table) (id : Nat) (first last : Option Row) :
    put (put rows id first) id last = put rows id last := by
  funext subject
  by_cases same : subject = id <;> simp [put, same]

theorem put_expected (row : Row) : put base 7 (some row) = expectedRows row := by
  funext id
  by_cases same : id = 7 <;> simp [put, base, expectedRows, same]

theorem actual_eight_success : claimed.matched = true ∧
    launch (deliver base claimed .commitAck) key 70 next (some "new release") (.ok (claimed.rows 7)) =
      .started context ∧
    succeeded.native.attempts = expectedEight ∧ succeeded.native.result = .ok () ∧
    succeeded.recorded.response = .ok true ∧ succeeded.recorded.rows = expectedRows expectedSuccess ∧
    succeeded.native.native = 9 ∧ succeeded.loggedRecordingError = none := by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
  change put (put base 7 (some (expectedClaim seed 70 next 0))) 7 (some expectedSuccess) = _
  rw [put_same]
  exact put_expected expectedSuccess

theorem listener_not_attempted : invoke context .waitListener ∉ succeeded.native.attempts := by
  rw [actual_eight_success.2.2.1]
  decide

theorem rejects_nine : succeeded.native.attempts ≠ expectedAttempts context := by
  intro same
  have length := congrArg List.length same
  change (8 : Nat) = 9 at length
  omega

/-- Exact instantiated ordered_success conclusion is false although the worker
commits its complete durable success row and returns acknowledged true. -/
theorem rejects_ordered_success :
    ¬(succeeded.native.result = .ok () ∧ succeeded.native.attempts = expectedAttempts context) := by
  intro ordered
  exact rejects_nine ordered.2

/-- Same conjunction as the ORIGINAL Fixture.accepted_success theorem,without
importing its correctness module. The only changed intended output is attempts. -/
theorem rejects_accepted_success :
    ¬(claimed.matched = true ∧
      launch (deliver base claimed .commitAck) key 70 next (some "new release") (.ok (claimed.rows 7)) =
        .started context ∧
      succeeded.native.attempts = expectedAttempts context ∧ succeeded.native.result = .ok () ∧
      succeeded.recorded.response = .ok true ∧ succeeded.recorded.rows = expectedRows expectedSuccess ∧
      succeeded.native.native = 9 ∧ succeeded.loggedRecordingError = none) := by
  intro accepted
  exact rejects_nine accepted.2.2.1

#print axioms actual_eight_success
#print axioms listener_not_attempted
#print axioms rejects_ordered_success
#print axioms rejects_accepted_success

run_cmd do
  for declaration in [``put_same, ``put_expected, ``actual_eight_success, ``listener_not_attempted,
      ``rejects_nine, ``rejects_ordered_success, ``rejects_accepted_success] do
    let axioms ← Lean.collectAxioms declaration
    for name in axioms do
      unless name == ``propext || name == ``Classical.choice || name == ``Quot.sound do
        throwError "unexpected listener fault diagnostic axiom in {declaration}: {name}"

end ComputerLifecycle.ListenerOmissionDiagnostic
